pages.text: Burns $(l)Biogas$() or $(l)Methane$() into FE, 20 mB per tick.$(br2)It is a small multiblock: $(l)place a Cyber Frame in front of it and one behind$(). $(l)Right-click$() the machine and mini drones fly out and

project the frames where they go (hold sneak to place a frame against the machine itself). With both there it assembles: the duct and the nozzle slide out of the drum and the rotor blooms. It does not work until then, so a turbine placed before this change waits for its frames, with its gas kept; move any pipe

that sits where a frame goes.$(br)$(li)$(l)Biogas$(): 5 FE per mB, 100 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Methane$(): 12 FE per mB, 240 FE/t$(br)$(li)Holds $(l)16,000 mB$() of gas and $(l)50,000 FE$(). It only burns gas when its energy buffer has room, so no gas is wasted.
$(li)Like the $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l), it $(l)pushes power$() into adjacent machines and $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l), up to 400 FE/t per side.

$(li)Feed it with $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipes$(/l) or any other mod's fluid pipes. Pipes and conduits connect at the three mint sockets of the machine block, on either side or on top, whichever you prefer.

$(li)The rotor turns as fast as it makes power, so methane spins it faster than biogas. The slits on its flanks show the gas left. Breaking a frame folds it back and stops it; put the frame back and it opens again.
